title: ho mubarak qalq ka hajat rawa paida hua
body:
ho mubarak qalq ka hajat rawa paida hua
momino ka aatwa ye rehnuma paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
noor se saara jaha'n roushan hua taa aasmaa'n
aaj dunya me wo noore kibriya paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kyu na qush ho mominee'n hai aaj jashne shaahedee'n
musie kazim ka ab ye mailaqa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haqeeqat husne yusuf ki bhala peshe raza
noore haq shaahe huda yusuf laqa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
haatife ghaibi nida deta hua phirta hai yu
shaad ho sab mominee'n haajat rawa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
ab hue paida janabe hazrate moosa raza
shor ek salle alaa ka jaabaja paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
noor se saara jaha'n ab ek ba ek roushan hua
jis ghadi ye maahe nu noore quda paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
haajate'n shio ki bar laaye quda ab jald tu
iske sadqe me jo shaahe dosara paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jahannum ka tujhe dar aye naseebe khush naseeb
aaj baalaae zamee'n moula tera paida hua
